name: implied_vol_dislocation_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: On NIFTY, when India VIX is significantly elevated relative to the index's own rolling 5-minute realized volatility, options market makers are pricing in more risk than actual price action warrants — they have accumulated excess long-delta spot positions from delta-hedging short puts at inflated IV, and as each bar passes without the feared volatility materializing, that hedge-unwind pressure eases and creates a mild upward drift (buy CE when ratio z-score is high and 1-min return turns positive). Conversely, when NIFTY's 5-minute realized vol sharply exceeds VIX, an unexpected volatility burst is underway: institutional stop-loss cascades are moving the index faster than options participants priced, and the directional momentum — confirmed by the 1-minute return — tends to persist for another 15-45 seconds before options repricing can catch up (buy PE when RV > VIX and 1-min return is negative).

indicators.name: rv_60
indicators.purpose: 5-minute rolling annualized realized vol. SHORT enough to capture current intraday volatility regime (not yesterday's), long enough to smooth 5-second noise. This is the intraday equivalent of the original's 20-day RV — we want 'what is NIFTY actually doing RIGHT NOW' vs what VIX implies over the next 30 days. 60 bars = 5 minutes is the minimum window producing a stable rolling stddev estimate from 5-second returns without requiring 20 days of daily data.

indicators.name: vix_close
indicators.formula: India VIX close, joined backward to spot bars, fill_null=15.0
indicators.purpose: Options market's annualized implied vol for the next 30 days. Used as IV proxy — avoids needing per-strike IV computation from the option chain. Represents the 'priced-in fear' we compare against actual 5-min realized movement.

indicators.name: iv_rv_ratio
indicators.purpose: Core signal: ratio of VIX (as decimal) to 5-min realized vol (as decimal). Ratio > 1 means VIX exceeds recent realized vol (options overpricing fear). Ratio < 1 means VIX below recent realized vol (momentum burst underway). Direct analog of original's vix / rv_20d, transposed to intraday timescale.

indicators.name: ratio_zscore
indicators.purpose: 20-minute (240-bar) rolling z-score of iv_rv_ratio. WHY 240 bars: normalizes the ratio within TODAY's session context — some days VIX is structurally elevated or depressed, and we want to detect UNUSUAL dislocations relative to the session's own IV/RV regime. NOT 12x the original lookback (which would be 20 * 252 * 12 = nonsensical). The 20-min window anchors to intraday regime while being responsive enough to detect dislocations that resolve in 15-45 seconds.

indicators.name: mom_12
indicators.purpose: 1-minute (12-bar) return. Directional CONFIRMATION: the IV/RV ratio tells us the regime but not the immediate direction of resolution. mom_12 confirms which way the dislocation is resolving. For buy_ce (VIX >> RV): need momentum already turning positive to confirm the fear is actually fading. For buy_pe (RV >> VIX): need negative momentum confirming the downward cascade is in progress, not yet exhausted.

conditions: ratio_zscore > zscore_threshold (VIX z-score significantly above session baseline — fear premium is excessive relative to today's IV/RV norm)
mom_12 > min_momentum (1-min return positive — upward resolution already begun)
buy_ce.confirmation: Both conditions true on the same 5-second bar

conditions: ratio_zscore < -zscore_threshold (intraday RV significantly exceeds VIX — unexpected volatility burst, options market lagging)
mom_12 < -min_momentum (1-min return negative — directional cascade in progress)
buy_pe.confirmation: Both conditions true on the same 5-second bar

exit.stop_rationale: 4 option pts = ~8 NIFTY spot points at delta 0.5. In a 15-second dislocation-resolution trade, if NIFTY moves 8 spot points against the thesis within the first few bars, the IV/RV dislocation thesis is clearly wrong for this bar cluster. Calibrated to the upper bound of the 15-30s typical option move range (2-5 pts), using slightly above that range to give the trade room while still cutting losers quickly.
exit.target_rationale: 6 option pts = ~12 NIFTY spot points. The expected 15-45 second resolution of a VIX/RV dislocation (delta-hedge unwind easing or stop-loss cascade continuing) historically produces 10-15 spot point directional moves on NIFTY. 6 pts captures the lower bound of that range with 1:1.5 R:R (stop 4, target 6).

filters.vix_filter: core to strategy — VIX is the IV proxy
filters.time_filter: 09:30-15:20 IST (15-min warmup for RV accumulation; avoid expiry-day final 10 min)
filters.volume_filter: none — NIFTY index volume is noisy at 5-second bars
filters.spread_filter: none — limit order execution, no spread cost in pipeline

edge.edge_decay_risk: low — VIX vs intraday realized vol dislocation is structural (options market prices 30-day horizon, NIFTY 5-min RV prices current-session reality)

adaptation_notes: Original traded top-15 NIFTY-beta stocks at 1-min bars using 20-DAY realized vol (a slow regime signal firing 3-5x per MONTH). The adaptation keeps the contrarian directional thesis — VIX >> RV → market overpricing fear → upward bias (buy CE); RV >> VIX → momentum burst underway → continuation bias (buy PE with negative confirmation) — but replaces: (1) equity universe with NIFTY index; (2) 20-day RV with 5-minute rolling RV (the intraday equivalent of 'current actual volatility'); (3) absolute ratio thresholds with a rolling 20-min z-score so the signal adapts to each day's own IV/RV regime; (4) 60-200 minute hold with a 15-45 second hold, enforced via time_stop_bars=9. The directional logic is inverted from the CONVENTIONS reference iv_dislocation example (which uses IV > RV to predict a DOWN move): this strategy follows the original's explicit contrarian thesis — fear premium (high VIX) exhausting without confirming volatility → mean-reversion to calm → long index.
weaknesses: VIX vs 5-min intraday RV dislocation may persist longer than 45 seconds without resolving — time_stop will be hit frequently on buy_ce trades
On structurally high-VIX days (VIX > 25), ratio_zscore may flag buy_ce continuously without producing clean upward drifts
rv_60 at 5-second resolution can be noisy on NIFTY due to zero-volume bars early in session
buy_pe arm (RV burst > VIX) fires less frequently — fewer short-side opportunities vs buy_ce
